dedupe_keys.name: entreprises transports transports maritime et fluvial

description: Entreprises - Transports - Transports maritime et fluvial is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by STATEC Institut national de la statistique et des études économiques du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg. This dataset includes the following resources: - Activities of the Port of Mertert (tonnes) - Locked boats in Grevenmacher (upstream and downstream) - Luxembourg flagged fleet 1993 - 2011 - Fleet under Luxembourg maritime flag --- Automatically synced from the LUSTAT database. Coverage: STATEC Institut national de la statistique et des études économiques du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg. The portal shows the English title as "Companies - Transport - Maritime and inland waterway transport" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is STATEC Institut national de la statistique et des études économiques du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg. Its keywords include entreprises, maritime, fluvial, statistiques, transports, statec-sync. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-zero. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
